# Decision analysis (generated by scripts/analysis.py; do not edit)

Base case: lead-2 forecasts, 839 days (01 Jul 2024 – 19 Oct 2026), notified rules on the final X path, contract rate ₹2.82/kWh. All ₹ figures are lakh per year for the 100 MW plant, scaled from the backtest days to 365. The optimiser picks percentiles on days before 2025-07 and is scored on the days after; rows marked *out-of-sample* compare every model on those later days only.

## 5. Battery that absorbs deviations

Net ₹ lakh/yr avoided (loss avoided minus energy lost at 88% round trip), 2-hour battery behind the meter, GBM + optimiser schedule.
